name: The Creator OS
oneLiner: Ken’s whole record cut as one edit: a program monitor, colour-coded tracks for builds, film and writing, the paused Digest as its own automated track, and a playhead that re-tunes the page to any moment.
type: Big Shoulders Display (slate titles) · Schibsted Grotesk (reading) · DM Mono (timecode, receipts)
signature: The Playhead: drag, step (← → / J L), switch tracks (↑ ↓) or play the year across every clip in Ken’s record, and the program monitor, the ‘Tuned to’ workspace (builds, videos, essays, photos, interests) and the URL follow it; every clip comes from the graph, so new work joins the edit by itself.
